title: Micah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Micah 1: Yahweh coming down from his place, the rubble heap Samaria becomes, and the lament over the towns from Gath to Lachish.

questions.text: In the days of which kings of Judah did Yahweh's word come to Micah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

questions.text: What are the melting mountains compared with?
questions.explanation: The mountains melt under him and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire and like waters poured down a steep place.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will make Samaria like?
questions.explanation: He will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, pour down its stones into the valley and uncover its foundations.

answers.text: A rubble heap of the field

questions.text: What will happen to Samaria's idols?
questions.explanation: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, her temple gifts burned with fire and all her images destroyed.

answers.text: They will be carried to Jerusalem
They will be hidden in the valley
They will be beaten to pieces
They will be sold to the nations

questions.text: What does the speaker say he will howl like?
questions.explanation: He says he will lament and wail, go stripped and naked, howl like the jackals and moan like the daughters of owls.

questions.text: Verse 9 says that it has come even to Judah. To the gate of which city does it reach?
questions.explanation: Her wounds are incurable, for it has come even to Judah and reaches to the gate of his people, even to Jerusalem.

questions.text: Where does the speaker say he has rolled himself in the dust?
questions.explanation: He says not to tell it in Gath and not to weep at all, and that at Beth Ophrah he has rolled himself in the dust.

questions.text: What does verse 11 say about the inhabitant of Zaanan?
questions.explanation: The inhabitant of Shaphir is to pass on in nakedness and shame, and the inhabitant of Zaanan will not come out.

answers.text: That they will flee to Gath
That they will not come out
That they will build the wall
That they will sing for joy

questions.text: Which city's inhabitant is told to harness the chariot to the swift steed?
questions.explanation: The inhabitant of Lachish is told to harness the chariot to the swift steed, for she was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion.

questions.text: What is the baldness to be enlarged like, in the last verse?
questions.explanation: They are to shave their heads and cut off their hair for the children of their delight, and enlarge their baldness like the vulture.
